chunks: And whoever is blind in this [world] will be blind in the Hereafter and more astray in way.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of being blind in this world and the Hereafter according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a causal link where the spiritual blindness in this world (al-basara) leads to a more profound, permanent blindness in the Hereafter (al-a'ma), emphasizing that worldly neglect of divine signs results in eternal misguidance. It underscores the principle that the soul's condition in dunya is a precursor to its state in akhira, serving as a warning for believers to maintain spiritual awareness through contemplation and action.
